reviews.text:
I recently discovered Stellski Café & Coffee, which is conveniently close to our home, and I must say it has quickly become one of my favorite breakfast spots in Woodstock.

My wife and I were simply looking for a nice place nearby to have breakfast, but this place completely exceeded our expectations. The food and coffee are honestly some of the best you can find in the area. Everything tastes fresh, thoughtfully prepared, and full of flavor.

One dish that really stood out for me was the Smoked Trout on Rye, beautifully served on toasted bread with cream cheese and pickled red onion. The balance of flavors was incredible, and it’s easily one of the best breakfast meals I’ve had in a long time.

The café also has a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere that makes it a great place to sit down, enjoy your coffee, and take your time. It has that perfect neighborhood café feeling where you can slow down and just enjoy the moment.

A special thank you to Noncedo, who served us. The customer service was warm, attentive, and genuine, which made the whole experience even better.

I’ll definitely be coming back. Not too often though, because this is the kind of place you want to keep special, where you go when you want excellent food, great coffee, and a relaxed vibe.

Highly recommended if you're in Woodstock.

Popular spot for a morning coffee and breakfast with amazing coffee, and oat bowls. Pet friendly patrons and staff with pets allowed inside as well as outside. Afternoons are quieter if you need somewhere quiet to work from. A lovely fireplace for cold winter days too.

The wait staff all love children, and it’s not uncommon to see local babies and toddlers being carried around while working, and giving the parents a quick reprieve.

The only downside for those with babies is there is no changing table or changing space in the small bathroom.

places.name: Vista Cafe
places.address: 44 Hertzog Blvd, Foreshore, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa

reviews.text:
Yo, if you want to start your day the right way, you need to know about Vista Cafe.
I’m there literally every single day before work to grab my breakfast, and let me tell you, they have never disappointed me. Not once.
If you go, you’ve got to try the bacon, mushroom, and cheese omelette—it’s brilliant. But the absolute king of the menu? The ultimate favorite? It’s their double cheeseburger special. Guys, it comes with chips for only R99. R99! In this economy? And this burger is honestly the best thing ever. It is completely consistent—always tastes exactly the same, always fills you right up.
But the cherry on top is the service. They are so friendly. I just call in to place my order, and by the time I walk through the door, everything is ready and waiting for me in the smoking area. I just sit down and immediately dig in.
Do yourself a favor and try it out!
